description: Get what the site needs to read published Mapled content: the delivery key (it starts with mk_live_ and reads published content only — not an agent token, mcp_live_, nor a server key, msk_live_; when the person has to place it on the host, their way is Integrations → the "Your site" card → the "Delivery key" row → "Copy"), the API URL, the package for the site's framework (`sdk`), the env var the key goes in (`envVar`), how the site renders (`rendering`: server or browser) and `wireUp` — the steps for that framework; follow them. Pass `framework` as you see it in the repository: "nextjs" (@mapled/next), "react-spa" for a React single-page app such as Vite (@mapled/react), "plain-html" for pages without a build step (@mapled/vanilla: one script tag and data-mapled-* attributes on the elements — no reading code to write, wireUp lists the attributes), "astro" (@mapled/astro: the same reads plus the webhook, preview and live routes in Astro's idioms), "nuxt" (@mapled/nuxt: the module mounts the routes, useMapled() reads), or another short key (remix, sveltekit, … — @mapled/client on the server); left out, the project's own is used. The JavaScript packages have the same reads: createClient({ key }).getRecords("<collection>"), getSingle, getRecordBySlug. Reads take filter ({ field: value } or { field: { gte, lt, in, contains… } }), sort, limit/offset, fields, and expand (relation fields, e.g. ["author"]; a relation inside a components field's blocks as "field.sub", e.g. ["sections.picks"]) — linked records arrive under record.expanded, a block's under record.expandedBlocks.<field>, one entry per block in the list's order; getRecordBySlug(collection, slug) reads one record by its slug field. Image values are asset ids: assetUrl(id, { width, format }) from the same package gives the URL of a resized variant. rich_text values are Markdown — render them with a Markdown component (e.g. react-markdown), never as raw HTML (@mapled/vanilla renders them itself: data-mapled-format="markdown"). Content appears on the site only after a human presses Publish in Mapled.
name: get_connection
